The most common reason deals die is not rejection. It is silence.

A rep sends one email, gets no response, and moves on. The data is clear: 80% of sales require five or more follow-up touches. Most reps stop after two.

Not because they do not want to follow up. Because manually tracking who needs a follow-up and when, across 50 active leads, is a full-time job on top of the actual selling.

We published a piece this week that maps the four sales workflows where AI delivers the fastest revenue impact — with actual trigger-action sequences, not vague categories.

The one that surprised me most: the lead enrichment workflow. Teams that implement automated enrichment and routing report a 40-60% reduction in time-to-first-contact and a 15-25% improvement in first-call conversion rates. Not because the AI is better at sales. Because the rep arrives prepared instead of cold.

If your sales team is spending more time on admin than on conversations, this is worth reading.

twitter_thread: 80% of sales require 5+ follow-up touches. Most reps stop after 2. Not because they do not want to follow up — because manually tracking 50 active leads is a full-time job. Here are the 4 AI workflows that fix this:

Workflow 1 — Lead enrichment: lead enters CRM → company data pulled, ICP score calculated, rep briefing document generated, Slack notification sent — all before any human touches the record. 40-60% faster time-to-first-contact. 15-25% better first-call conversion.

Workflow 2 — Outreach sequencing: lead qualified → Day 1 email → Day 4 follow-up (different angle) → Day 9 LinkedIn connection → Day 14 final close. Sequence runs automatically. Rep handles the replies. 100% follow-up completion rate vs. 1-2 touches manually.

Workflow 3 — Pipeline monitoring: deal quiet for 14 days → Slack alert with re-engagement draft. Call completed → AI generates summary, updates CRM, creates follow-up tasks. Weekly pipeline report generated automatically every Monday.

Workflow 4 — Sales forecasting: every Friday, all open deals pulled, historical conversion rates applied by stage and rep, weighted forecast calculated, gap to target quantified, deals most likely to close surfaced. Model-based, not rep-stated probability.
What AI cannot replace in sales: the discovery call, the relationship, the negotiation. AI handles the 60-70% that follows rules. The rep handles the 30-40% that requires judgment.
